ADD_LIBRARY (steam_audio INTERFACE)

TARGET_COMPILE_DEFINITIONS (steam_audio INTERFACE "_CRT_SECURE_NO_WARNINGS")

TARGET_INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES (steam_audio INTERFACE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/include")

IF (CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE STREQUAL "Debug")
	TARGET_LINK_LIBRARIES (steam_audio INTERFACE
		"${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/lib/debug/phonon.lib"

)
ELSEIF (CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE STREQUAL "Release")
	TARGET_LINK_LIBRARIES (steam_audio INTERFACE
		"${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/lib/release/phonon.lib"

)
ELSE ()
	MESSAGE (FATAL_ERROR "Unknown build type: ${CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE}")
ENDIF ()
